name: autowfo_survival_gate_policy_v1
purpose: Freeze the structural Survival Gate policy contract before implementing gate parsing, verdict writing, or risk-engine behavior.

policy_identity.versioning_rule: Changing thresholds, required metrics, scope, or verdict semantics requires a new policy_version.

verdict_contract.immutability_rule: Do not overwrite historical verdicts. Re-scoring writes a new verdict_id.

policy_invariants: Win rate alone cannot produce a pass verdict.
A policy cannot evaluate micro_live or scaled_live without kill-switch fields.
A verdict cannot be written without policy_id and candidate_id.
Threshold values must come from frozen evidence, observed distributions, or explicit operator risk tolerance.
Changing threshold values requires a new policy_version.
initial_non_goals: No permanent numeric win-rate, drawdown, profit-factor, or paper-day thresholds are frozen by this protocol.
No live trading activation is implied by this protocol.
No risk engine implementation is implied until evidence warehouse outputs exist.
invalidation_rule: If allowed verdict values, capital stages, or required verdict fields change, this protocol must be reopened and re-frozen before gate implementation proceeds.
